practice.q: Practice 17 [semantic distinction] — Balanced cultural discussion: Distinguish طبلہ from بیت بازی in meaning and use.
practice.answer: طبلہ means “tabla”; بیت بازی means “verse-capping”. Their context and grammatical role determine the choice.
practice.skill_target: Urdu semantic distinction: Urdu agreement, postpositions, honorificity, and formal versus everyday register
